constraints.name: element_usage_limit
constraints.description: Each element of the given word sequence may be used at most once in the verse; if a word appears k times in the input, it may be used up to k times (each occurrence separately).
constraints.formal: For each i, word W_i can be used at most once in the whole verse.

constraints.name: stanza_pair_structure
constraints.description: A stanza must consist of exactly two words; a verse is a (possibly empty) list of such stanzas.
constraints.formal: A verse is a sequence of pairs {(a_1, b_1), ..., (a_m, b_m)} where each a_i, b_i are chosen from the input words.

constraints.name: allow_unused_elements
constraints.description: It is not necessary to use all given words; any subset (respecting element usage limits) may form the verse.
constraints.formal: The number of words used in the verse is ≤ N.

constraints.name: alphabet_restriction
constraints.description: All words consist only of lowercase English letters.
